If you feel more "put-together" after trimming, that’s a form of **self-validation**. It’s okay if this feels important to you—many people find grooming rituals empowering. Some people thrive on quick, efficient mornings; others need that extra time to feel centered. Both are fine—what matters is that it works for *you*.
